newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 6.06 pct at Italy BOT buyback.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 6.06 pct at Italy BOT buyback.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 3.0 trillion lire buyback of short term Treasury bills (BOTs) by the Bank of Italy was 6.06 percent compared with 6.37 percent previously, the Bank said.
The average rate was 6.28 percent against 6.46 percent at the previous operation for 2.5 trillion lire on June 20.
The Bank said 2.884 trillion lire of the 3.0 trillion on offer had been taken up and the bank received 16 bids, all of which were met in full.
